# Instructions

Pick the best hand(s) from a list of poker hands.

See [Wikipedia][poker-hands] for an overview of poker hands.

[poker-hands]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_poker_hands

---
Implement this in `poker.py`. The tests are in `poker_test.py`; make them pass, and do not modify them. Keep the names of existing functions and classes, since the tests import them. Use only the Python standard library.
